messages:
lee: T-minus 60 for the EU change window. Quick preflight: pin artifact, DB migration plan confirmed, and webhook backoff enabled. tagging owners: @anya @mike. Any blockers?

anya: ACK. Migration is a harmless index add, reversible. I ran it on staging and it completes in ~3m.

mike: ACK. I uploaded release notes and included post-GA rollback steps. Link: https://internal.redwood/relnotes/3.8.x

dev-bot: /pin artifact v3.8.1 -> scope=canary,owners=[mike,lee]
dev-bot: PIN APPLIED: v3.8.1 (lock: lock-20260321-1901)

lee: Rollback triggers (agreed): >2pp 5xx spike for 5m, p95 +250ms for 5m, or any data integrity incident. Oncall will cut to 0% and rollback if hit.

oncall-sre: Monitoring set. Alert thresholds configured. I'll page if any trigger fires.

anya: Canary will start at 10% with KV cache warmup and no aggressive batching for first 20m.

mike: Starting canary ramp now:
```bash
./rollout --artifact v3.8.1 --target canary --traffic 10
```

dev-bot: canary: nodes canary-a/b started, healthchecks OK, latency p95=140ms, 5xx=0.03%

lee: Holding 15m steady. If green, we move to 50% then GA after 30m quiet window. No manual unpin without owners + release manager.

mike: Copy. Posting short rollback playbook below in case: 1) /rollback artifact v3.8.1 2) revert traffic 3) re-open old lock 4) run postmortem.

anya: Minor note: customers on legacy SDK may see auth retries; mitigation toggled. Added to release notes.

lee: All good here. Proceeding to 50% if +15m stays green. Leaving thread open for final signoff. :thumbsup:
